output.headline: Dental-only acquirer with three closed dental deals, one in the Southeast; the target fits its bolt-on playbook.
output.differentiator: Largest median deal among the dental-only strategics on the list, with every deal closed and one already in the Southeast, so the target is a familiar kind of deal.
output.why_them: Dental bolt-on to an established platform; full closing record

acquirer_overview.title: A dental specialist that has closed every deal it started
points: Three deals from 2020 to 2022, all in dental and all closed (3 of 3, 100%) [T:record, K:closed_share].
Ranked 3rd on the priority list of 10 and 3rd overall among 107 buyers scored, at a likelihood of 5.3% [R:rank].
Company profile and buyer revenue not researched, so the parent's scale is unconfirmed [B:buyer, V:synergy].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Same sub-sector, same region precedent, platform-build motive
points: Share of its deals in dental is the strongest factor in its likelihood; margin fit and close rate are modest positives [S:sector_share, S:margin_fit, S:close_rate_s].
Platform Build in 2 of 3 deals, a motive on only 23% of deals in the file, points to add-on appetite [M:platform_build].
Bought Strategic Oral Health in the Southeast in 2020, so the target's region is not new to it [D:MA-2020-0159].

precedent_activity.title: Three dental deals, one bolt-on, all larger than the target
points: Quality Orthodontics: $176M bolt-on, 2022, at 12.4x. Pacific Oral Health: $168M management buyout, 2020, at 13.2x [D:MA-2022-0229, D:MA-2020-0247].
Strategic Oral Health: $392M platform investment in the Southeast, 2020, at 17.0x [D:MA-2020-0159].
None of the three falls in the comparable size band of $40M-$160M [K:size_band].

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible; its own history sits lower
points: 63 comparable deals, 12 in dental: 11.0x at the 25th percentile, 13.7x median, 15.4x at the 75th [V:comps].
Target margin of 18.0% beats the comps' median of 12.4% and sits above 92% of comps, supporting the 75th percentile [V:comps].
Its median paid is 13.2x; synergy headroom of $5M-$9M gives room to stretch toward the 75th. Buyer revenue not researched [V:comps, V:synergy].

risk_flags.title: Size stretch
risk_flags.concern: All three precedents are above the target's size; the smallest was $168M against an $80M target.
risk_flags.mitigant: Quality Orthodontics was a bolt-on, the same deal type as this target.
risk_flags.reality: No deal in the $40M-$160M band; small-deal appetite is unproven [K:size_band, T:record, D:MA-2022-0229].

risk_flags.title: Price discipline
risk_flags.concern: Its median paid of 13.2x is below the comparable median of 13.7x and the 75th percentile of 15.4x.
risk_flags.mitigant: It paid 17.0x for Strategic Oral Health, and synergy headroom is $5M-$9M.
risk_flags.reality: Upper-quartile pricing needs a stretch beyond its usual multiple [T:record, V:comps, D:MA-2020-0159, V:synergy].

risk_flags.title: Thin recent activity
risk_flags.concern: Only 1 deal since 2022, and its last was in 2022; recency counts slightly against it.
risk_flags.mitigant: Every deal it started has closed, 3 of 3.
risk_flags.reality: Current appetite is unconfirmed; the buyer's profile was not researched [K:recent, S:recency, K:closed_share, T:record].

conviction.rationale: Three deals in the target's own sub-sector and none in adjacent ones, one deal in the Southeast, and a rank of 3rd among the highest-scored buyers after review support the call [C:conviction, R:rank].
